answer: Optical physical unclonable function attestation protects an AI-agent economy from Sybil attacks. Each autonomous falcon node authenticates by scattering laser light through an embedded synthetic opal wafer to generate a unique speckle pattern. An attacker incurs the verifiable hardware cost of fabricating a distinct nanostructured crystal per identity. However, thermal shifts induce a refractive delta that alters diffraction, causing occasional false rejections of valid nodes.
